ai_positioning.summary: Lamb Weston Holdings has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided 10-K/20-F extracts. AI positioning is not identifiable from available information.

risks.title: Cybersécurité
risks.score_rationale: Company has established cybersecurity governance with Board oversight, dedicated CISO, and regular program reviews, but cyber threats remain inherent to operations. CISO recently appointed (March 2025) with extensive 20+ years experience.
risks.summary: Company manages cybersecurity risks through structured governance and experienced leadership, with ongoing program development and regular board oversight.

risks.title: Concurrence
risks.score_rationale: Highly competitive market environment with significant pricing pressures requiring ongoing customer investments. Company acknowledges increasingly competitive landscape impacting price/mix and margins. Competition is primary driver of current margin compression.
risks.summary: Intense competitive pressure in frozen potato market requiring substantial price/trade investments and impacting gross margins and segment profitability.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Persistent inflationary pressures documented in fiscal 2025 including increases in potato costs, labor, packaging, and transportation. Manufacturing costs per pound increased significantly. These factors directly contributed to gross profit decline of 21%.
risks.summary: Material inflation across input costs (potato, labor, packaging, transportation) constraining margins despite some price mitigation actions in key markets.

risks.title: Réglementation
risks.score_rationale: Company notes potential impacts from trade policy changes and tariffs, with One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) enacted July 4, 2025. Impact evaluation ongoing with expected cash tax timing benefits and no material effective tax rate impact.
risks.summary: Evolving trade policies and tariff environment present potential operational and financial impacts, currently under evaluation with OBBBA expected to provide timing benefits.

risks.title: Géopolitique
risks.score_rationale: Company operates in over 100 countries with exposure to global macroeconomic and geopolitical pressures. Management outlook reflects continued pressure on consumers from geopolitical factors and uncertainty affecting restaurant traffic globally.
risks.summary: Global geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainties affecting consumer spending and restaurant traffic in key markets, impacting demand for frozen potato products.

risks.title: Réputation
risks.score_rationale: Product safety incident in prior year with voluntary withdrawal in Q4 fiscal 2024 resulted in estimated $9 million incremental loss. Risk managed through quality control and established brand equity, but reputational impact possible from operational issues.
risks.summary: Prior year product withdrawal managed and resolved; ongoing product quality and food safety protocols in place to protect brand reputation and customer relationships.

risks.title: Financier
risks.score_rationale: Significant earnings pressure expected in fiscal 2026 from carryover price investments, cost inflation, and incremental depreciation. Net income declined $368.3M in fiscal 2025. Company implementing $250M cost savings program by FY2028 and expects $120M working capital improvements.
risks.summary: Financial performance under pressure from competitive pricing investments and cost inflation, partially offset by restructuring initiatives and aggressive cost reduction program targeting $250M savings by FY2028.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.

fr.customers: Les clients principaux de la société sont les grandes chaînes de supermarchés, les restaurants et les chaînes de restauration rapide.

en.activity: Lamb Weston Holdings, Inc. is a leading global producer, distributor, and marketer of value-added frozen potato products.
en.products: The company's main products are French fries, mashed potatoes, and shredded potatoes.
en.customers: The company's main customers are large supermarket chains, restaurants, and fast-food chains.

en.positioning: Lamb Weston Holdings, Inc. is a leader in the value chain of frozen potato products, with a strong presence in the North American market and a capacity to innovate.
